QF.id: AIF Valuation Taxation and Good Practices_32

answer.text: AIF unit issuances and transfers as per applicable stamp duty laws

explanation.text: The Logic: Per NISM XIX-A (p. 265), fund documents and investment documents may be subject to stamp duties and local taxes, and the issue, transfer, and sale of units of the Fund are specifically subject to stamp duty under applicable stamp-duty rules. RTAs collect stamp duty on issue/transfer/sale of units of AIFs. The Trap: Stamp duty is not limited to stock-market transactions, government bonds, or real estate alone. AIF unit transactions fall within its scope. Note: Distributors should be aware that stamp-duty cost is borne by the investor at the time of issue, transfer, or sale of AIF units.
